title: Browser UI kit: driving the Claude and ChatGPT pages, ALCHEMYFETCH, and the mail nudge
purpose: Tell any chat what the browser UI kit does for it (fetch a document it cannot reach; be told when it has Rasen Falcon mail), how a chat is bound to its lane, and the safety rules the kit keeps. Read before asking ALCHEMYFETCH for anything, before relying on mail nudges, or before changing the kit.
